D-01_ff.reason: Both verified peer-reviewed MD studies found on this exact repeat unit (PEO/PEG, *CCO*) use non-PCFF fields: OPLS-AA (10.3390/polym13224049, bulk neat PEO melt, exact-SMILES) and GAFF (10.1039/d4ra04898a, PEG oligomers, exact-SMILES). No verified paper in this search validates PCFF/Class-II specifically on POXI. The plan's own D-01_ff evidence leans on Klajmon2023, which is a protocol/equilibration-error benchmark across PLA/PEG/PVP, not a PCFF-vs-alternative accuracy comparison, plus an uncited 'NkepsuMbitou2025' claim ('PCFF outperforms GAFF2') that has no resolvable DOI anywhere in the plan -- it cannot be verified as literature support. Countervailing: the evidence store also holds two internal_validated_run records showing PCFF already built and passed density/Tg/bulk_modulus gates on this exact SMILES in prior PolyJarvis runs (PEG1, PEG1_gate_validation) -- real in-pipeline precedent the external OPLS-AA/GAFF papers do not have. That tempers this to a flagged literature disagreement for the adjudicating critic to weigh, not grounds for an automatic override.

dominant_uncertainty: Whether PCFF vs. OPLS-AA/GAFF materially changes PEO/PEG density-Tg-K accuracy for this exact SMILES: published MD literature validates OPLS-AA/GAFF on this polymer, PolyJarvis's own gate-passing history validates PCFF in-pipeline, and no head-to-head PCFF-vs-OPLS-AA benchmark for POXI exists to resolve the two.
notes: D-01_ff (pcff) disagrees with the two verified peer-reviewed MD studies found on this exact repeat unit (both non-PCFF: OPLS-AA and GAFF), but PCFF already has internal_validated_run precedent for the same SMILES in this pipeline, so this is reported as a literature gap for the adjudicating critic to weigh -- not a forced override. Electrostatics (pppm) and the experimental Tg band (158-233 K, bracketing the plan's own 206 K target) are both independently corroborated by the same literature and require no change.

sources.claim: All-atom PEO melt MD study (up to 300 ns production per temperature) uses the OPLS-AA force field throughout; simulated density at 300 K (1.071 g/cm3) is stated by the authors as consistent with experimental data (1.112 g/cm3, and a 1.07-1.27 g/cm3 literature range), and the study's own MD Tg (249 K) is consistent with prior MD studies (Tg~251 K) and within the cited experimental Tg range (158-233 K).

PEG oligomer (n=2-7) MD study uses the General AMBER Force Field (GAFF); for the tetramer at 328 K, GAFF reproduces the experimental density (1096.0 +/- 0.1 kg/m3 exp vs 1143.3 +/- 0.1 kg/m3 sim) within ~5%.
"The long-range electrostatic contributions are calculated by using the Ewald summation." (mesh-Ewald/PPPM class method for all-atom PEO melt MD).
"For the treatment of long-range electrostatic interactions, the Ewald summation method was employed."

Reports own MD Tg (OPLS-AA, stepwise cooling, 4x10^9 K/s) of 249 K; cites the experimental literature Tg range for PEO as 158-233 K and a prior MD study giving Tg~251 K, calling its own result consistent with both.

md_studies.title: Temperature Dependence of Conformational Relaxation of Poly(ethylene oxide) Melts
md_studies.ensemble: stepwise-cooling all-atom MD melt, up to 300 ns production per temperature (NPT/NVT split not captured in the stored claim text)

Simulated Tg (249 K) exceeds the paper's own cited experimental range (158-233 K) and instead tracks a separately cited prior-MD value (~251 K) -- read as MD-vs-MD consistency, not tight agreement with experiment.
